section_heading: 3.3 PILOTAGE SERVICES (continuation), 3.4 SURVEY/EXAMINATION OF SMALL VESSELS AND LIFE SAVING APPLIANCES, 3.5 PILOTAGE EXEMPTION CERTIFICATE
plain_summary: This page details specific pilotage surcharges for the Port of Durban related to service cancellation. It also lists a charge for PLO duties for pilots on board tanker vessels at the Port of Saldanha. General exemptions for pilotage services are provided for SAPS and SANDF vessels. The page then introduces fees for surveying small vessels and life-saving appliances. Finally, it outlines the fee structure for Pilotage Exemption Certificates, which varies based on the vessel's length overall (LOA), including minimum charges and per-metre rates for different LOA bands. Exemptions for SAPS and SANDF vessels also apply to these certificates, and rules for their validity and endorsement are mentioned.
